name: Find The Football Clubs (130)
desc:
Welcome to the Find The Football Clubs

In this game, you aim to find the Football Clubs found in the worlds!

Count of FC = 150

💡 How to play:
- Look for Football Clubs
- When you find a Football Club, touch it
- Collect 150 FCs around the game 🎌

👍 Click like if you like the game
